title: 30A Beach House Scissortail at Treetop Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Beach House pet friendly rental, Scissortail at Treetop, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House pet friendly rental, Scissortail at Treetop, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - Treetop Village* 4 Bedrooms, 4.5 Bathrooms* Pet Friendly* Spacious Balconies* Large Living Area - 65" Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed , 35" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 35" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 3 - King Bed, 35" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 4 - 3 Bunk Beds (Q/Q, Q/Q, F/F), 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Half Bathroom* Washer/Dryer * Parking* Complimentary High Speed WI-FI* Sleeps 18 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT TREETOP VILLAGE IN SEACREST, FL This gated Seacrest community is nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach offering a prime 30A location. The community includes easy access with 2 private entrances off 30A and Hwy 98. Guests will enjoy being within walking distance to all the shops and restaurants at Seacrest, Alys and Rosemary Beach. COMMUNITY AMENITIESPoolWalk to Restaurants and Shops Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome well trained non-shedding dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
